component.name: Sudden Strike II (Native Engine)
component.summary: Native SDL3 and Vulkan reimplementation of Sudden Strike II Gold 2.2

description.p: An open, cross-platform native C++20/SDL3/Vulkan 1.3 engine for Sudden Strike II (Gold 2.2) supporting the full 136-mission campaign and single-player suite, 2-4 player lockstep multiplayer, 2x HD packs, and out-of-the-box community mods (sudtest.ini VFS chains, unpacked/gzip overlays, and .ssx addon packs). User-supplied original or GOG game files are required.
